title: Relative flatness of a module under scheme base change
statement: Let f:X→S and p:T→S be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-base-change]. If a quasi-coherent O_X-module F is flat over S [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], then the ordinary tensor pullback of F by X×_S T→X [def-pc-module-pullback] is flat over T. No finiteness or flatness hypothesis is imposed on f or p.

source.place: Section 10.100, Lemma 10.100.1(1), proof; applied to the affine stalk description of base change

proof.text: Obtain quasi-coherence of tensorPullbackObj by uniqueness of left adjoints: tensorPullback and the native Scheme.Modules.pullback are left adjoint to the same pushforward, and native pullback preserves quasi-coherence. Transport the property along their component isomorphism.

Apply relative_flat_of_stalks to the second projection. At z, let M be the stalk of F at the first projection. Give the source stalk its base algebra via f.stalkMap. relative_flat_module_stalk f F hflat supplies base-flatness of M.

Apply pullback_stalk_relative_flat_extension to M. The natural tensor-pullback stalk isomorphism, restricted to the new base stalk, identifies the desired stalk with this flat module. Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv transports flatness and completes the pointwise criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem relativelyFlat_module_pullback
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (p : T ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hflat : F.IsFlatOver f) :
    (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f p) F).IsFlatOver
      (pullback.snd f p)
